messages:
Bryan (PM): quick sync — we need final call on the new ‘Performance Plus’ packaging. customer asks piling up. do we bundle SLA + dedicated or make them add-ons?
Esther (Sales): customers want predictable latency + a formal SLA. preference is bundle for enterprise deals, add-on for self-serve.
Mike (Eng): from infra side bundling SLA implies reserved capacity and SLO runbooks. can do, but capacity commit impacts costs.
Sasha (Finance): if bundled we should set a minimum monthly commit (eg $25k/mo) or effective unit price goes up. otherwise margin drops.
Nora (Legal): SLA language needs clear scope & exclusions. also call out force-majeure and maintenance windows. happy to draft once scope decided.
Bryan (PM): good — two axes: packaging (bundle vs add-on) and limits (soft cap vs hard cap + overage). quick proposal: bundle SLA + 30d retention for enterprise commits >= $25k/mo; add-on options for smaller customers. thoughts?
Esther (Sales): that maps well to AE playbook. would add early-access for 3 pilot customers so we can measure latency percentiles.
Mike (Eng): prefer soft cap with throttling + notification + paid overage. hard caps cause bad UX and support churn. we can implement burst tokens that refill daily.
Sasha (Finance): payout model for overage: 1.5x list $/token for burst usage after cap. also recommend minimum 6mo billing on committed tiers.
Bryan (PM): code snippet of proposed pricing table: 

```
Tier,IncludedTokens/mo,MonthlyPrice,OverageRate,CommitMin
Performance Plus,1,000,000,000,$25,000,0.000025,6mo
Performance Core,200,000,000,$6,000,0.00003,1mo
```

Mike (Eng): implementational note — KV cache sizing and reserved GPU pool changes if we go >1B tokens. need infra plan by end of sprint.
Nora (Legal): also flag data residency for the private deployment customers. add option: VPC-only for Performance Plus enterprise.
Esther (Sales): question: do we include burst credits in the bundle or sell separately? bundles win deals but reduce upsell.
Sasha (Finance): sell burst as an add-on with a block of tokens (eg 200M) at a discount vs pay-as-you-go. keeps revenue predictable.
Bryan (PM): launch gating proposal: 1) 3 pilot customers on committed plan for 30d with SLOs observed; 2) infra stress test at peak qps + documented rollback; 3) legal sign-off on SLA + contract template; 4) pricing & billing workflow validated with finance.
OpsBot: incident policy template created: /policies/slo-sla/performance-plus-v1 — created by OpsBot at <link>
Esther (Sales): +1 on gating. can line up pilots — I have 2 interested logos.
Mike (Eng): I'll own infra plan and perf runbook, will post PR for rollout checklist by Wed.
Sasha (Finance): I'll model revenue impact for bundle vs addon and share next-day.
Nora (Legal): I'll draft SLA + VPC appendix and send to Bryan for review.
Bryan (PM): ok action list: Mike - infra plan & perf runbook; Sasha - finance model; Nora - SLA & VPC appendix; Esther - secure pilots; Bryan - finalize pricing table and commit language. target: decision sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
